with recursive tree as ( select id, id as root from litemall_category where pid = 0 and deleted = 0 union all select c.id, t.root from litemall_category c join tree t on c.pid = t.id where c.deleted = 0 ) select t.root as categoryId, cat.name as name, count(*) as onSaleCount, coalesce(sum(cp.eu_stock_num is not null), 0) as probedCount, coalesce(sum(cp.eu_stock_num > 0), 0) as euStockedCount, round(avg(case when cp.eu_stock_num > 0 then cp.eu_stock_num end), 1) as avgEuStock from litemall_goods g join tree t on t.id = g.category_id join litemall_category cat on cat.id = t.root left join litemall_cj_product cp on cp.pid = g.cj_pid and cp.deleted = 0 where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.source = 'cj' group by t.root, cat.name
